about: Pricing benchmark fixture cases: hand-written body-fragment HTML in the style of vendor pricing pages, product pages, review sites, articles and market-research snippets (invented companies). Labels follow README.md and were written from the text alone by a labeller who has not seen the extractor. Each page lists one expected entry per distinct price statement (repeats in different elements are labelled separately) and not_prices for amounts that are not prices of the product.
